title: Google copybara: moving code between repositories
summary: Google Copybara is a declarative tool for transforming and migrating code between repositories, enabling automated large-scale code refactoring and synchronization across multiple codebases with custom transformation rules.
problem_solved: Solves the challenge of maintaining code consistency across multiple repositories during large-scale refactoring or migration, which is error-prone and time-consuming when done manually.
why_valuable: It automates complex, multi-step code transformations at scale while enforcing validation rules, significantly reducing human error and engineering time for monorepo-to-polyrepo migrations and bulk refactoring projects.
